notes: ASSUMED backend contracts for conductor reconciliation (Lane A A2/A3/A4 not yet landed on disk when this ran; each getter is locked by a fetch-mocked regression in client.test.ts so drift is caught): (1) GET /reports/drivers -> { days: DriverReportDayDto[], totals: DriverReportTotalsDto }. DriverReportDayDto = { day (ISO yyyy-MM-dd, Prague-local), ridesCompleted, ridesCancelled, cashTotalCzk, cardTotalCzk, invoiceTotalCzk, totalCzk, hoursOnline, priceOverrideCount }. totals adds avgRating:number|null. CSV variant GET /reports/drivers?format=csv returns the server-built CSV BYTES as a blob (client NEVER rebuilds CSV per AC#7); filename read from Content-Disposition (RFC 5987 + plain), with a range-derived fallback if the server omits it — VERIFY the server sets Content-Disposition, else the client owns the name. (2) GET /reports/fleet -> { kpis: FleetKpiDto, ridesPerDay: {day,rides}[], topRoutes: {routeId,name,count}[] }. FleetKpiDto = { rides, revenueCzk, avgPriceCzk, avgTimeToAssignSeconds, avgTimeToPickupSeconds, cancellationRate(0..1), appShare(0..1), fixedRouteShare(0..1), smsCount, smsCostCzk }. RECONCILE: field names for the shares (appShare vs appVsPhoneShare) and whether times are seconds vs ms; UI formats seconds->'m min s' and fraction->'%'. (3) GET /reports/ratings -> ASSUMED NAMED { ratings: RatingDto[] } envelope (mirrors the zones/routes/places convention, NOT { items }); RatingDto = { stars, comment:string|null, orderCode, driverName }. (4) GET /audit?actor&entity&from&to&orderCode&page -> { items: AuditEntryDto[], total, page }. AuditEntryDto = { source('OrderEvent'|'AuditLog'), at(ISO UTC), actorUserId:string|null, actor:string|null (role label), entity, event(OrderEventType or audit action string), orderCode:string|null }. page is ZERO-BASED in the client; PAGE_SIZE=50 assumed for hasNext computation — RECONCILE page base (0 vs 1) and page size with A4. event-label map: order-event types reuse orders.timeline.event.* (13 types incl. PriceOverridden); ASSUMED audit-action strings are ['StatusOverridden','DriverStatusOverridden'] mapped to audit.event.* — SOURCE-VERIFIED that manual driver-status override writes ONLY audit_log (OverrideStatusEndpoint), never an order_event, so it appears on /x/audit but NOT in the order-detail drawer; reconcile the real AuditLog action string(s) against ASSUMED_AUDIT_ACTIONS in src/shared/audit/auditEventLabel.ts. Unknown/unrecognised events fall back to audit.event.Unknown (graceful, never crash, never raw string). KEY DECISIONS: (a) RidesChart is hand-rolled plain <svg> (pure geometry in ridesChartGeometry.ts) — NO chart lib; size 233.49kB < 260kB budget. (b) The shared event-label map was placed in src/shared/audit/ (NOT features/audit/ as the WI path listed) to avoid a cross-feature import (orders<->audit both consume it); ALL_ORDER_EVENT_TYPES/OrderEventType canonical source moved there and re-exported from features/orders/eventTimeline.ts for back-compat. (c) B2's WI file paths (board/orderDetail/OrderTimeline.tsx) are fictional — the real timeline is features/orders/OrderEventTimeline.tsx + eventTimeline.ts; extended in place (now uses auditEventLabelKey). (d) CSV blob download uses a dedicated fetch in client.ts (fetchDriverReportCsv) that attaches Authorization+X-Fleet-Slug like apiRequest but reads response.blob() — apiRequest does response.json() and cannot be reused. (e) /x/reports + /x/audit are lazy-loaded chunks (ReportsPage-*.js, AuditPage-*.js confirmed separate in dist); FleetAdmin-gated via canAccessSettings; nav links added (FleetAdmin only). /d and /c untouched. (f) Default date range = this Prague month (reportDateRange.ts, Intl tz Europe/Prague), money integer CZK via shared formatCzk, audit timestamps Europe/Prague. i18n reports.* + audit.* + nav.reports/nav.audit added to BOTH cs.json and en.json (parity test green). B3 (admin + /x/settings Fleet tab extensions + onboarding e2e) intentionally NOT built — clean seams left. ===== RECONCILE PRIORITY (these three ASSUMPTIONS break RENDERING if the real DTO differs — elevate above mere type drift; all test mocks use the assumed shapes so they will NOT catch a mismatch): (P1) FleetKpiDto share field names — UI reads kpis.appShare + kpis.fixedRouteShare + kpis.cancellationRate as 0..1 fractions; if A3 names them differently (e.g. appVsPhoneShare) formatPercent(undefined) renders 'NaN %'. (P2) avgTimeToAssignSeconds / avgTimeToPickupSeconds are assumed SECONDS; if A3 returns ms the magnitude is silently wrong. (P3) audit `page` is assumed ZERO-BASED and PAGE_SIZE=50 drives hasNext; if A4's page is 1-based or the size differs, paging is off-by-one / first page may render empty. (P4) DriverReportDayDto.day + RidesPerDayDto.day MUST be a BARE ISO date 'yyyy-MM-dd' (Prague-local) — DriverReportTable.formatDay splits on '-' and RidesChart keys/labels on it; a full ISO timestamp ('2026-09-01T00:00:00Z') renders garbage. Confirm A2/A3 emit bare dates. ===== TDD NOTE for impl-reviewer: pure modules + contract locks were genuinely RED-first where a real failure surfaced (e.g. the en-CA->formatToParts date bug was observed failing then fixed); several component tests were authored alongside their component and RED was inferred from the full-suite run rather than observed per-test-first. Tests are substantive (axe, paging, filter, label exhaustiveness, CSV blob) — not redone.
